activation.reason: Configured managed roots activate the reversible launcher while verified native worktrees remain adopted.

bridge.contract: An executable on PATH accepts one lifecycle capability name and emits a public-safe JSON availability receipt. For nextTurnInput, a pending receipt may contain only a bounded plain-English prompt, 2-3 choices, a listed default, and an opaque correlation identifier; hooks display it without granting authority. Native hooks do not capture arbitrary reply text: the in-session agent verifies an exact listed reply, then invokes `jarvos-stewardship-bridge answer --correlation <correlation> --choice <listed-choice>`, which passes only those two bounded fields.

checkpoint.reason: Codex does not use a stable-idle lifecycle hook for this adapter.

stop.reason: Codex stop handling remains a managed-launcher responsibility.

controlPlane.parity: Human CLI and agent MCP delegate to the same installed authenticated application service. Public/minimal setup registers the shared MCP without host bindings; when either host env is set, both absolute non-secret paths are required and verified. Setup never registers the raw credential value; the MCP server reads the secret at runtime.
